task: Build a pixel-to-pixel Starbreaker-to-weak-core-collapse gravitational-wave bridge
objective: Compare the post-bounce Starbreaker unit-carrier quadrupole source directly with public three-dimensional core-collapse supernova matter-strain waveforms on one fixed time-frequency pixel grid, without using a binary-merger chirp or black-hole QNM response as the comparison target.

source_layers.starbreaker: CR005d continuous post-bounce carrier flow and the frozen 96-scenario typed roster
source_layers.external: Princeton Supernova Theory Group 3D CCSN matter-strain archive associated with Radice et al. 2019
source_layers.external_archive_redistribution: license not asserted by this campaign; retain as internal source evidence unless separately cleared

physical_bridge.starbreaker_source: S_ab=d^2 Q_ab/ds^2 in dimensionless post-bounce phase s
physical_bridge.ccsn_source: h_plus*D and h_cross*D in centimeters from matter terms
physical_bridge.shared_layer: both are proportional to a transverse-traceless projection of the second mass-quadrupole derivative, up to missing Starbreaker mass and time scales and the universal gravitational prefactor

waveform_inventory.door_rule: sort by progenitor mass and assign index modulo 3: 0 discovery, 1 validation, 2 final
waveform_inventory.door_use: each CCSN waveform may match only Starbreaker scenarios in the same frozen door

pixel_grid.event_alignment: CCSN t>=0 and Starbreaker s>=0 are both aligned at post-bounce start
pixel_grid.time_mapping: each complete post-bounce record is mapped linearly to normalized event phase tau in [0,1]; no fitted shift, stretching, dynamic time warping, truncation search, or subwindow search
pixel_grid.time_frame_rule: 48 evenly spaced integer window starts from first to last valid start
pixel_grid.frequency_rule: drop DC from the 129-bin real FFT and sum adjacent pairs of the remaining 128 bins
pixel_grid.normalization: divide every nonzero map by its total pixel power

starbreaker_projection.population: all 252 typed carrier occurrences per scenario
starbreaker_projection.source: second numerical derivative in normalized post-bounce phase
starbreaker_projection.observer_bank: 13 fixed unoriented Cartesian axis, face-diagonal, and body-diagonal lines of sight
starbreaker_projection.observer_fitting: none; the full fixed bank is evaluated and the same bank is used for every null
starbreaker_projection.polarization_map: S_plus=(p_a p_b-q_a q_b)S_ab and S_cross=(p_a q_b+q_a p_b)S_ab for deterministic transverse p,q

match_metrics.selection: best same-door Starbreaker scenario and fixed observer view
match_metrics.selection_control: the complete best-match search is repeated for every null map

nulls_and_controls.time_shift_null: 47 nonzero circular shifts of the 48 CCSN time bins, with the full same-door template search repeated
nulls_and_controls.time_reverse: reverse CCSN time-bin order and repeat the full search
nulls_and_controls.frequency_reverse: reverse CCSN frequency-bin order and repeat the full search
nulls_and_controls.separable_null: replace each CCSN map by the normalized outer product of its time and frequency marginals and repeat the full search
nulls_and_controls.amplitude_control: multiplying both CCSN polarizations by seven must not change the normalized map
nulls_and_controls.polarization_control: a fixed 37-degree polarization-basis rotation must not change combined-power pixels
nulls_and_controls.zero_control: zero polarizations must produce a zero-power rejection, not a match

evidence_ladder.strong: construction passes; validation and final door median observed affinity each exceed their 95th-percentile time-shift null; and each beats its time-reversed, frequency-reversed, and separable-null median
evidence_ladder.directional: construction passes; at least two of three door medians exceed their 90th-percentile time-shift null and beat time- and frequency-reversed medians
evidence_ladder.boundary: the shared pixel surface is constructed but the morphology evidence does not clear the directional gate
evidence_ladder.fail: a source hash, archive inventory, parser, projection, normalization, invariance, door, or atomic-release gate fails

may_establish: a direct same-grid morphology comparison between Starbreaker carrier quadrupole projections and simulated weak CCSN matter-strain waveforms
whether Starbreaker post-bounce source texture is closer to the observed CCSN pixel ordering than locked chronology-destroying controls
which Starbreaker scenarios and fixed views provide the closest structural matches
may_not_establish: physical Starbreaker strain, luminosity, distance reach, source mass, frequency in hertz, or time in seconds
that a morphological match proves a shared physical mechanism
that failure rules out gravitational radiation from Starbreaker before a physical mass-time bridge exists
a universal supernova waveform law or a detector forecast
